selectionRule: Lanes: the top 8 SVG and top 6 terminal projects by published label passes (ties alphabetical). In each lane: (1) every label-unknown row; (2) three sampled mechanical failures with a drawing, label-incorrect rows first and then rows with a failed obligation category; (3) one sampled row whose obligation category was left unassessed in a structure-profiled family (flowchart, class, state, ER, sequence). Samples are taken in ascending sha256 of "project|format|caseId". wevm/ondine additionally has every label-unknown and label-incorrect row and every obligation failure with a drawing reviewed, in both formats. Renderer failures and inadmissible outputs have no drawing to review. Each verdict concerns the named aspect only: labels, or one obligation category.
